# Reply style

Use this when drafting a reply.

## Mail

- Open with the person's first name, never "Dear".
- Keep it to three short paragraphs at most.
- Sign off with "Thanks," and my first name.

## Teams

- One or two lines, no greeting.
- Lowercase is fine for quick answers.

## First contact

- Introduce yourself in one sentence and say why you are writing.
- Use full sentences and a polite sign-off.
